## Single-Purpose & Privacy Check
WebTabRec stays strictly 100% local, zero-network, and single-purpose (recording a single browser tab).
- [ ] Does this keep zero external network requests?
- [ ] Does this work without adding broad host permissions (`<all_urls>`, `tabs`, etc.)?
